findings.title: Closed-PR status card lacks [Re-attempt later] [Forget] (DESIGN §14.11.11)
findings.detail: The coder left this as an open question because it conflicts with AC 30. DESIGN already says 'AC 30 rules still apply', so the owner should decide what Re-attempt later means for a CLOSED contribution, or drop the button. Forget does not depend on AC 30. TRACEABILITY CR3-IH-2 is marked 'done' but should note it is partial until then. Carries to the Phase 2 gate.
